validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE/SPEC: confirmed by 2 independent government/state-media sources naming this exact segment (Liuzhou-Guilin), not GEM-derived. (1) gx.chinanews.com.cn (2023-09-30, Guangxi Chinanews) reports the 'Guangxi LNG supporting export pipeline Guilin branch' (广西LNG配套外输管道桂林支线) ran Liuzhou Transmission Station (Luonan/Luoman Town) -> Guilin Transmission Station (Sitang Town), 155.7 km, 813 mm diameter, 10 MPa design pressure, Phase-1 capacity 2.5 bcm/y, completed an 8 MPa/72-hour trial run and was commissioned 2023-09-29 -- this matches GEM's Length (155.70 km), Diameter (813 mm), Pressure (10.00 MPa), Capacity (2.50 bcm/y), StartYear1/Month1 (2023-09) and Status=operating exactly. (Note: url_verifier flagged this URL as a false negative on '桂林'/'2.5' -- likely an encoding/rendering artifact in the automated fetch; a WebFetch read of the same URL returned the full matching figures verbatim, so I'm citing it.) (2) sasac.gov.cn (2019-12-25, State Council SASAC, sourced from Sinopec) reports the 'Guangxi pipeline Guilin branch' (广西管道桂林支线) broke ground 2019-12-17 in Liucheng County, Liuzhou, as part of the national 'south gas north' mid-corridor (Beihai-Liuzhou-Guilin-Hengyang-Qianjiang...), design length 165 km -- this matches GEM's ConstructionYear/Month (2019-12). The 165 km design figure vs. 155.7 km as-built figure is a normal pre-construction-estimate-vs-final gap (~5%), not a red flag; the as-built 155.7 km from the 2023 commissioning article is the correct current value and is already what's on the sheet. CLASSIFICATION: correctly a transmission trunk segment (part of the national south-gas-north corridor), not a gathering/distribution line -- confirmed. DUPLICATE CHECK vs roster: P4718 ('Liuzhou Branch') shares the identical StartLocation string ('Liuzhou Transmission Station, Luoman Town, Liunan District') but is a distinct, much shorter segment (29 km, 610 mm) running Liuzhou->Liudong Transmission Station -- a different physical spur off the same hub station, not the same pipe as this 155.7 km Liuzhou->Guilin trunk. Not a duplicate. FuelSource='Guangxi LNG Terminal' is consistent with both sources, which describe this branch as the outlet moving Beihai-LNG-sourced gas north. CAVEAT: Operator/Owner ('National Pipe Network Group Southwest Pipeline Co Ltd' / 国家管网集团西南管道有限责任公司) has no ref on the sheet (MISSING_REF) and I could not find a source naming this specific segment's operator. Independent search confirms PipeChina Southwest Pipeline Co Ltd (Chengdu-based, est. 2020 restructure) is the umbrella operator of ~5,200 km of oil/gas pipe across Guangxi (>80% of the province's long-distance pipe) via its Nanning Oil & Gas Transmission Branch, and a Guangxi-specific EIA filing confirms that branch's full legal name is '国家管网集团西南管道有限责任公司南宁输油气分公司' -- so the GEM parent-company name is directionally correct, but this is province-wide corroboration, not segment-specific, so I did not stage it as a fill (see fills[] note).

status_reviews.researcher_notes: Status=operating is correctly recorded and current. The gx.chinanews.com.cn article (2023-09-30) documents the branch completing its 72-hour trial run at 8 MPa and being formally commissioned 2023-09-29, i.e. genuinely operating, not merely under trial. Dormancy rules (2y->shelved / 4y->cancelled) don't apply -- this row is already operating, not proposed/shelved. Searched for anything more recent (2024-2025 news on '桂林支线 天然气管道', expansions, incidents, or reversals) and found nothing segment-specific: only a 2024-06-13 cnstock.com piece on PipeChina's Guangxi company network-integration strategy in general terms (no article body accessible to confirm segment-level detail) and unrelated 2024-2025 Guangxi gas-network items (Baise-Wenshan LNG line, etc.). No evidence of any status reversal since the 2023-09 commissioning, so I'm treating 2023-09 as the most recent confirming evidence and standing by 'confirm' rather than forcing a newer date I can't source.

summary: P4719 (Liuzhou-Guilin Branch, Guangxi LNG Terminal Transport Pipeline) confirmed real and correctly specced/classified against 2 independent state-media/government sources (155.7km/813mm/10MPa/2.5bcm/y/2023-09 commissioning all match; 2019-12 construction-start also matches); not a duplicate of P4718 despite sharing a start-station string. Operator/Owner ref remains unresolved -- no segment-specific source found, only province-wide corroboration of the parent company name (UNRESOLVED, left unfilled rather than pairing a weak generic ref).
